If omitted, all fields are returned. For example, to get just the total number of items and the request limit:
`fields=total,limit`

`fields=items(added_at,added_by.id)`
Use multiple parentheses to drill down into nested objects, for example:
`fields=items(track(name,href,album(name,href)))`

Endpoint: PUT /me/albums

Endpoint: PUT /playlists/{playlist_id}

"

Endpoint: GET /me/following
Specification: "description": "Get the current user's followed artists.\n" "operationId": "get-followed" "summary": "Get Followed Artists\n"

Endpoint: GET /me/player/recently-played

Endpoint: GET /playlists/{playlist_id}/tracks

"

If omitted, all fields are returned. For example, to get just the total number of items and the request limit:
